465. Nth Term of a Sequence

90

Hard  Topics

Problem Statement:
A sequence is given by: 2, 6, 11, 17, 24,....
The first term is 2.
Given an integer N, find the Nth term of the sequence.
1 <= N <= 10^18
Since the answer can be very large print it modulo 1,000,000,007 (10^9 + 7)
input_spec: The only line of input contains an integer N
output_spec: Print the Nth term of the sequence
